include_content_type.description: Include meta.content_type for notebooks and insights on this page, without their contents.

include_tags.description: Include meta.tags, the tag names, for dashboards and insights on this page.

limit.description: Number of results to return per page.

offset.description: The initial index from which to return the results.

parent.description: Only entries under this folder path, at any depth, such as 'Experiments/Q4'.

path.description: Only the entry at exactly this path.

ref.description: Only entries pointing at this item: the insight or notebook short_id, or the dashboard id. Combine with type to find an item's entry in the project tree.

type.description: Only entries of this type, such as 'insight', 'dashboard', 'notebook' or 'folder'.
